title: Righteousness by Faith
blurb: A judge calls a guilty man righteous. Is it a cover-up? No: God's word is a seed, and it brings faith, forgiveness and power.

said.text: Righteousness by Faith rewrite: the shape (ask a5d4e2f6b76): spine: B · The word is a seed (recommended): it answers "cover-up?" with a picture, and makes country living part of the answer · thesis: "The just shall live by faith." (Hab 2:4; Rom 1:17): it answers Job's "just" and lands on "faith" (recommended) · opening: The verdict first: a guilty man hears "righteous", then the verses that seem to clash, then Job's question (recommended) · accused: Max, told as a parable ("Picture a young man…"), no name in speech (recommended) · length: About 7 minutes of speech, like the old film, with the time moved to the two stories (recommended) · reach: One short glance ahead: the latter rain, and sins blotted out (Acts 3:19) (recommended) · version: Yes, v3, written from scratch; the new script sits beside the old one until you keep it (recommended) · more: No, go write it
Keep the refrain of three, faith, forgiveness and power, counted in the paralytic (Mark 2) and the woman (John 8) as in his sermon of 2026-04-25; it lives inside the spine, the word is a seed
